query.text: 请看着我用盲杖走路，如果前方有障碍物或危险请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch me walk with my white cane, and warn me in time if there are any obstacles or dangers ahead.

annotation.text_zh: 注意，正前方有行人和行李箱，请减速。
annotation.text_en: Watch out for the pedestrians and luggage ahead, please slow down.
